title: Teamwork Lifts the Stone

dialogue.speaker: fern
dialogue.text: Bramble, can we lift this big stone together for the stack?

dialogue.speaker: bramble
dialogue.text: Yes, with steady paws and a gentle ask we succeed

dialogue.speaker: fern
dialogue.text: I’ll say thank you to the meadow as we lift

dialogue.speaker: bramble
dialogue.text: Our teamwork makes the tower rise higher and brighter

dialogue.speaker: fern
dialogue.text: The Glimmer’s lights dance, rewarding our polite teamwork today

dialogue.speaker: bramble
dialogue.text: Together we learned asking helps even the heaviest stones move
